item.title: MatrAIx Paper Proposes Simulating 8.3 Billion Persona Agents Across 1,290 Dimensions
item.summary: A 93-author preprint introduces MatrAIx, an infrastructure that constructs 8.3 billion persona agents across 1,290 categorical dimensions to evaluate AI systems at population scale, achieving 91.5% behavioral adherence in controlled validation trials.
